title: Hide the card number
prompt:
Write a function `mask(card)` that takes a card number as a string and returns a string of the same length where every character except the last four is replaced by `"*"`. If the string has four characters or fewer, return it unchanged.

For example, `mask("12345678")` returns `"****5678"`.
hints: `len(card) - 4` is the number of characters to hide, and `"*" * n` repeats a star `n` times.
The last four characters are the slice `card[-4:]`.
